verdict.rationale: The GeForce RTX 5070 Ti is a consumer graphics card, so subscribing to events through registrable outbound HTTP webhooks is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the product shipping any webhook capability; the items cover DLSS, Reflex, CUDA tooling and other graphics and AI features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
